messages:
alex: quick sync — we're T-6h from the quickstarts/changelog cutoff. final asks: docs, sample apps, SDK deps.

maria: thanks alex. small list from product: make sure the Python quickstart shows the new auth flow, and the JS sample uses the v2 SDK.

sam: CI on the sample-apps failed on flaky e2e (headless chrome). failing test: onboarding-flow.spec.ts  — I'm bisecting now. @jin can you own the PR for the JS SDK bump?

jin: I can take the SDK bump. PR is https://git.redwood/inference/sdk-js/pull/412 — will try to merge before cutoff. running local smoke.

lisa: docs note: the changelog draft has the new streaming section but the code snippet still shows `open_stream()` instead of `stream_response()`. I can patch but need the final API name from jin.

jin: API will be `stream_response(options)`; updated in PR but awaiting CI signal.

sam: CI flakes fix — I'm rerunning the sample-apps pipeline with updated puppeteer flags. If it passes I'll cut a patch PR: https://git.redwood/inference/sample-apps/pull/289

alex: ownership clarifications:
- docs: lisa (final pass + changelog)
- JS SDK bump: jin (merge + smoke)
- Python quickstart auth snippet: maria (update + verify)
- sample-apps e2e: sam (fix + patch)

maria: noted. I also need a quick sanity about size of the public quickstart tarball — CI artifact shrank by ~40% after the build change, want confirm nothing got pruned. @ci-bot can you confirm artifact size diffs?

ci-bot: artifact-report: sample-quickstart-v2.tar.gz: previous=12.1MB, current=7.3MB, files-removed: [examples/demo-data/*.csv]. Recommend re-adding demo-data or hosting externally.

lisa: hmm, demo data removal explains some broken examples in docs. prefer re-add to artifact for the release. sam — can you restore demo-data in the patch?

sam: yes, will include demo-data in PR #289 patch.

alex: release policy reminder — cutoff is 18:00 UTC. after that only rollback/critical fixes with +1 from product + devex lead. If any of the owners think their change won't land by cutoff, call it out here.

jin: heads up — my PR's flaky integration test is slow on macOS runners. If the merge is blocked by CI I'll open a hotfix PR that only renames `open_stream` to `stream_response` in README/sample code to unblock docs.

maria: that's fine. if it's only docs changes we can patch those post-cutoff under the rollback rule as long as they don't change API surface.

lisa: agree. if jin can't merge, I'll update code snippets to use `stream_response` and flag as docs-only change.

alex: one more: can everyone drop a quick thumbs when they have a green CI and ready-to-merge PR? makes the cut obvious. :thumbsup:

sam: running final pipeline now, will post back in 6m.

jin: local smoke green. waiting on CI.

lisa: docs edits ready in a branch, holding until jin confirms API merge.

ci-bot: pipeline status: sample-apps/e2e — retry #2 succeeded. artifacts rebuilt.

sam: :thumbsup: PR #289 updated with demo-data, CI green. ready.

jin: CI green on #412, merging in 2m.

alex: great — thanks all. I'll run the release checklist at 17:40 UTC and post any last-minute blockers. if nothing else, post your final thumbs by then.

maria: tagging the release doc: https://docs.redwood/inference/releases/2026-10-quickstarts (I've added the product blurb).

lisa: :thumbsup: all set from docs side once jin merges.

alex: closing loop — jin merged at 3520001330. final thumbs?

jin: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

lisa: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

alex: cutoff passed clean. thank you team. we'll run post-release smoke tomorrow morning for any regressions. :party_popper:
